scope_conventions: The poset is the finite current-forest grafting order, not entering-arity regular-algebra grading. The zeta transform keeps the complete kernels.
Protected registers and shared parameters are retained. Only actual eligible unmarked appends move; genuinely coupled updates are not factored into independently chosen marginal source sets.

Continuous segments are auxiliary interpolations. Accepting runs are finite and stop in ready states only; no infinite-run limit is a source witness. Zero-delta source operations are retained as zero-time auxiliary jumps with strict physical tuples.
The time bound is a monotone computational resource, not biological duration, word length or source size.

The fixed-RHA consequence fixes the automata, horizons and semialgebraic endpoint formulas over the entire rational-input family. It does not exclude input-dependent growing syntax or establish pointwise hardness.
